audit_items.proof_trace: The coset division and vanishing polynomial operations are implemented in the external c-kzg-4844 library (github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/v2), which is maintained by the Ethereum Foundation and used across all Ethereum clients. Prysm's code is a thin wrapper that validates structural constraints and delegates cryptographic operations to the external library. The property concerns the internal correctness of the c-kzg-4844 library implementation, not Prysm's usage of it.
